comparison.objective: Commission a shock absorber versus fit a spring tension rod level between two walls.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses hex-key engagement, collar rotation, and relocking; record compresses or shortens a spring rod, positions both end caps at a marked height, and releases it under preload.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two safe repeatable impacts; record requires both caps pressing the walls, rod self-supporting and still, level, and within the marked height band after release.
comparison.reason: Both involve spring-loaded hardware, but preloaded two-end placement does not test iterative damping adjustment. Candidate rebound, overload, and drift limits are missing.
